_comment: Per-archetype experience block overrides for dual-role positions. Keyed by company slug (matched case-insensitively against the ### role header line from cv.md). When the tailored generator finds a matching role, it replaces the whole role block with variants_{lang}[{archetype.lower()}] if present; otherwise the cv.md block is used unchanged. Each override is a full markdown role block (### header + optional intro + bullets + Stack line). Copy this file to experience-pool.json and populate. The populated file is gitignored. Only companies with genuine dual-role work need entries here — single-archetype roles need no overrides at all.

### Analytics Engineer · Example Analytics Ltd · London, UK · Permanent, March 2023 – Present

B2B SaaS analytics vendor. I owned the customer-facing data layer end to end.

- Consolidated 3 upstream systems into one warehouse on a deduplicated account spine, with 20+ dbt models and CI-gated tests on every merge.
- Re-architected the highest-volume revenue models as incremental with deterministic hash IDs, cutting daily compute roughly 10%.
- Introduced 100+ dbt and pytest tests across staging and marts, catching 10 upstream data-quality regressions before release.
- Shipped a lightweight FastAPI service exposing account-level metrics, replacing ad-hoc CSV exports for the dashboard team.

**Stack:** dbt · PostgreSQL · Python · FastAPI · GitHub Actions · Docker
